articles.summary: During 2025, through its network of subsidiaries, UHS served patients through 5.8 million encounters; employed approximately 101,500 individuals globally including nearly 26,000 nurses; invested $1 billion in equipment, facility expansions and renovations; and generated revenues of $17.4 billion, an increase of 9.7% over the prior year.
articles.title: Universal Health Services, Inc. Publishes 2025 Annual Report

articles.summary: The ribbon-cutting event marks a significant milestone for the seven-story, 365,000-square-foot, state-of-the-art facility, representing a nearly $430 million investment in the future of healthcare in Palm Beach County.
articles.title: Alan B. Miller Medical Center Celebrates Ribbon Cutting
